<template>
  <el-tag :type="priorityType[value]">{{ priorityMap[value] || value }}</el-tag>
</template>

<script>
import { priorityMap, priorityType } from '../constants'

export default {
  name: 'PriorityTag',
  props: {
    value: { type: String, default: '' }
  },
  data() {
    return { priorityMap, priorityType }
  }
}
</script>
